description: React component for listing project templates with functionalities to clone, view, edit, and delete templates.

methods.name: cloneProject
methods.description: Clones a project template by sending a POST request and navigates to the edit page of the new project.

methods.name: viewProject
methods.description: Navigates to the view page of a specific project template.

methods.name: deleteTemplate
methods.description: Deletes a project template by invoking the delete mutation.

methods.name: onAddProjectTemplateClick
methods.description: Navigates to the project creation page with template flag.
